# teams_online_voice_route (Data Source)

Look up an existing OnlineVoiceRoute object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `bridge_source_phone_number` (String) Maps to the -BridgeSourcePhoneNumber parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `number_pattern` (String) Maps to the -NumberPattern parameter.
- `online_pstn_gateway_list` (String) Maps to the -OnlinePstnGatewayList parameter.
- `online_pstn_usages` (String) Maps to the -OnlinePstnUsages parameter.
- `priority` (Number) Maps to the -Priority parameter.
